name: Palia – Bundles
description: The items the vault bundles of Palia ask for, by vault and bundle. The target is the amount the bundle needs.
tags: Bundle: Creatures of the Abyss Bundle
Bundle: Fruits of the Earth Bundle
Bundle: Pie in the Sky Bundle

items.name: Garden Mantis
items.description: The Garden Mantis can be found along the coastline of Kilima Lake in Kilima Valley, at any time of day.

items.name: Vampire Crab
items.description: Vampire Crabs can be found on the beaches surrounding the Flooded Fortress in Bahari Bay during the evening and night (6:00 PM - 3:00 AM).

items.name: Mutated Angler
items.description: The Mutated Angler is more attracted to Worms, and can be caught in Caves in Kilima Valley and Bahari Bay, as well as in The Underground, at any time of day.

items.name: Void Ray
items.description: The Void Ray is more attracted to Glow Worms, and can be caught in Caves in Kilima Valley and Bahari Bay, as well as in The Underground, at any time of day.

items.name: Green Pearl
items.description: Green Pearls have a small chance of being awarded when opening an Unopened Oyster.

items.name: Stripeshell Snail
items.description: Stripeshell Snails can be found along the Bahari Coast and in the Flooded Fortress in Bahari Bay, during the evening and night (6:00 PM - 3:00 AM).

items.name: Blue Marlin
items.description: Blue Marlin is more attracted to Worms, and can be caught at Bahari Coast in Bahari Bay, at any time of day.

items.name: Sushi
items.description:
The recipe for sushi is caught as a message in a bottle using a Glow Worm in Ponds in Kilima Valley, Bahari Bay, and the Player's Housing Plot, at any time of day.
Prep Station: Make Sushi using Dari Cloves, Heat Root, Any Fish, Vinegar, Rice and Sweet Leaf.

items.name: Inky Dragonfly
items.description: The Inky Dragonfly can be found near Bahari Rivers and Ponds in Bahari Bay, at any time of day.

items.name: Trout Dinner
items.description:
The recipe for Trout Dinner is learned from reading a book in Einar's Cave. The Player needs Friendship Level 3 with Einar to enter.
Standard Stove: Make a star quality dish using Any Trout, Any Spice, Potato, and Wild Garlic.

items.name: HydratePro Fertilizer
items.description: HydratePro Fertilizer can be purchased in quantities of 20 from the General Store for 40 Gold.

items.name: Giant Goldfish
items.description: Giant Goldfish is more attracted to Glow Worms, and can be caught in Ponds in Kilima Valley, Bahari Bay and the Player's Housing Plot, at any time of day.

items.name: Fisherman's Brew
items.description:
The recipe for Fisherman's Brew can be bought from Einar's Fishing Guild for 1,000 Gold after reaching Fishing Level 5.
Campfire: Make Fisherman's Brew using Emerald Carpet Moss and Crystal Lake Lotus.

items.name: Enchanted Pupfish
items.description: The Enchanted Pupfish is more attracted to Glow Worms, and can be caught in Kilima Lake in Kilima Valley, at any time of day.

items.name: Shimmerfin
items.description: The Shimmerfin is more attracted to Worms, and can be caught in Kilima Lake in Kilima Valley, at any time of day.

items.name: Long Nosed Unicorn Fish
items.description: The Long Nosed Unicorn Fish is more attracted to Glow Worms, and can be caught at Bahari Coast in Bahari Bay, during the day (6:00 AM - 6:00 PM).

items.name: Radiant Sunfish
items.description: The Radiant Sunfish is more attracted to Worms, and can be caught in Kilima Rivers in Kilima Valley, at any time of day.

items.name: Flametongue Ray
items.description: The Flametongue Ray is more attracted to Glow Worms, and can be caught in Kilima Rivers in Kilima Valley, during the morning and day (3:00 AM - 6:00 PM).

items.name: Striped Sturgeon
items.description: The Striped Sturgeon is more attracted to Worms, and can be caught in Kilima Lake in Kilima Valley, during the evening and night (6:00 PM - 3:00 AM).

items.name: Dawnray
items.description: The Dawnray is more attracted to no bait, and can be caught in Bahari Rivers in Bahari Bay, during the morning (3:00 AM - 6:00 AM).

items.name: Emberseeker Medallion
items.description: The first Medallion is given by Jina when you complete the Vault of the Flames quest, while the other five are hidden around Bahari Bay and take the appearance of treasure chests. See the guide here for exact locations.

items.name: Paper Lantern Bug
items.description: Paper Lantern Bugs can be found along the Bahari Coast in Bahari Bay, and also in the forests of north Bahari Bay, during the evening and night (6:00 PM - 3:00 AM).

items.name: Bahari Glowbug
items.description: The Bahari Glowbug can be found throughout the fields in south Bahari Bay, during the evening and night (6:00 PM - 3:00 AM).

items.name: Spitfire Cicada
items.description: Spitfire Cicadas can be found attached to medium and large Juniper Trees anywhere in Bahari Bay, during the morning and day (3:00 AM - 6:00 PM).

items.name: Firebreathing Dragonfly
items.description: Firebreathing Dragonflies can be found around the Mirror Pond Ruins, Mirror Fields, and by the Daiya Family Farm in Kilima Valley during any time of day.

items.name: Chapaa Masala
items.description:
The recipe for Chapaa Masala can be bought from Reth's Cooking Guild Store for 2,500 Gold after reaching Cooking Level 8.
Standard Stove: Make Chapaa Masala with Milk, Chapaa Meat, Butter, Spice Sprouts, Tomato, Dari Cloves, Wild Garlic, and Heat Root.

items.name: Heat Root
items.description:
Heat Root can be found growing on cliffsides in Bahari Bay at any time of day.
Alternatively, Heat Root can be purchased from the Foraging Guild Store for 6 Foraging Medals.

items.name: Phoenixfire Relleno
items.description:
The recipe for Phoenixfire Relleno can be bought from Reth's Cooking Guild Store for 2,000 Gold after reaching Cooking Level 7.
Standard Stove: Make Phoenixfire Relleno with Egg, Flour, Red Meat, Spicy Pepper, Spice Sprouts, and Cooking Oil.

items.name: Dari Cloves
items.description:
Rare and valuable, Dari Cloves can be found in the northern half of Bahari Bay at any time of day.
Alternatively, Dari Cloves can be purchased from the Foraging Guild Store for 12 Foraging Medals.

items.name: Jewelwing Dragonfly
items.description: The Jewelwing Dragonfly spawns exclusively on the cliffs above Pavel Mines in Bahari Bay, at any time of day.

items.name: Gossamer Veil Moth
items.description: Gossamer Veil Moths can be found around the fields of Kilima Valley, including Leafhopper Hills and Reflection Fields, during the evening and night (6:00 PM - 3:00 AM).

items.name: Golden Glory Bee
items.description:
Golden Glory Bees have a small chance to spawn after cutting down medium or large Birch Trees around Kilima Valley during the morning and day (3:00 AM - 6:00 PM).
Golden Glory Bees also have a small chance to spawn after taking down a honeycomb from trees anywhere in Bahari Bay and the Elderwood during these same hours.

items.name: Rainbow-tipped Butterfly
items.description: The Rainbow-tipped Butterfly can be found throughout the fields and cliffs of southern Bahari Bay, including Pulsewater Plains, Hideaway Bluffs, and above the Pavel Mines, during the morning and day (3:00 AM - 6:00 PM).

items.name: Stormseeker Medallion
items.description: The first medallion is given to the Player by Zeki when completing the Vault of the Gales Quest, while the others are located in treasure chests hidden around Bahari Bay. For help finding the chests, see this guide.

items.name: Crab Pot Pie
items.description:
The recipe for Crab Pot Pie can be bought from Reth's Cooking Guild Store for 1,000 Gold after reaching Cooking Level 5.
Standard Oven: Make Crab Pot Pie with Butter, Corn, Wheat, Onion, Any Vegetable, and Any Crab.
tags: Bundle: Pie in the Sky Bundle

items.name: Apple Pie
items.description:
The recipe for Apple Pie is learned from reading a book in Delaila and Badruu's Room. The Player needs Friendship Level 3 with Delaila to enter.
Standard Oven: Make Apple Pie with Butter, Wheat, Sweet Leaf, Spice Sprouts, and Apple.
tags: Bundle: Pie in the Sky Bundle

items.name: Blueberry Pie
items.description:
The recipe for Blueberry Pie can be bought from Reth's Cooking Guild Store for 1,500 Gold after reaching Cooking Level 6.
Standard Oven: Make Blueberry Pie with Butter, Wheat, Sweet Leaf, Spice Sprouts, and Blueberries.
tags: Bundle: Pie in the Sky Bundle

items.name: Shepp's Pie
items.description:
The recipe for Shepp's Pie can be bought from Reth's Cooking Guild Store for 1,500 Gold after reaching Cooking Level 6.
Standard Oven: Make Shepp's Pie with Butter, Corn, Salt, Potato, Carrot, Chapaa Meat, and Spice Sprouts.
tags: Bundle: Pie in the Sky Bundle

items.name: Rainbow Trout
items.description: The Rainbow Trout is more attracted to no bait, and can be caught in the Kilima Rivers in Kilima Valley, at any time of day.

items.name: Thundering Eel
items.description: The Thundering Eel is more attracted to Worms, and can be caught in Bahari Rivers in Bahari Bay, at any time of day.

items.name: Giant Kilima Stingray
items.description: The Giant Kilima Stingray is more attracted to Glow Worms, and can be caught in Kilima Lake in Kilima Valley, during the morning, day and evening (3:00 AM - 9:00 PM).

items.name: Stormray
items.description: The Stormray is more attracted to Glow Worms, and can be caught in Bahari Rivers in Bahari Bay, during the morning (3:00 AM - 6:00 AM) and the evening (6:00 PM - 9:00 PM).

items.name: Muujin Bahari
items.description:
The recipe for Muujin Bahari is purchased from Reth's Cooking Guild Store for 100 Cooking Medals after reaching Cooking Level 20.
Standard Oven: Make Muujin Bahari with Butter, Wheat, Corn, Salt, Chapaa Meat, Any Mushroom, Spicy Pepper, Onion, Spice Sprouts, Wild Garlic, Muujin Meat, Plant Fiber, Cooking Oil, Vinegar, and Egg.
tags: Bundle: Fruits of the Earth Bundle

items.name: Bacon-Stuffed Mushrooms
items.description:
The recipe for Bacon-Stuffed Mushrooms is learned after reading a book in the Daiya Family Farm kitchen.
Standard Stove: Make Bacon-Stuffed Mushrooms with Any Mushroom, Butter, Any Red Meat, Tomato, and Spice Sprouts.
tags: Bundle: Fruits of the Earth Bundle

items.name: Apple
items.description: Harvest Apples from the tree grown after planting an Apple Tree Seed in Soil on the Housing Plot.
tags: Bundle: Fruits of the Earth Bundle

items.name: Brightshroom
items.description:
Brightshrooms can be found near ruins, temples, and other ancient structures throughout Bahari Bay, at any time of day.
Alternatively, Brightshrooms can be purchased from the Foraging Guild Store for 6 Foraging Medals.
tags: Bundle: Fruits of the Earth Bundle

items.name: Stonefish
items.description: The Stonefish is more attracted to Glow Worms, and can be caught in Caves in Kilima Valley and Bahari Bay, as well as in The Underground, at any time of day.
tags: Bundle: Creatures of the Abyss Bundle

items.name: Hypnotic Moray
items.description: The Hypnotic Moray is more attracted to Glow Worms, and can be caught in Caves in Kilima Valley and Bahari Bay, as well as in The Underground, at any time of day.
tags: Bundle: Creatures of the Abyss Bundle

items.name: Ancient Amber Beetle
items.description: The Ancient Amber Beetle can be found in the Bahari Forest in north Bahari Bay, at any time of day.
tags: Bundle: Creatures of the Abyss Bundle

items.name: Leafstalker Mantis
items.description: The Leafstalker Mantis has a small chance to spawn after picking Sweet Leaf or Dari Cloves in north Bahari Bay, at any time of day.
tags: Bundle: Creatures of the Abyss Bundle

items.name: Rootseeker Medallion
items.description: The first medallion is given to the player by Einar when the Player completes the Vault of the Roots Quest, while the other five are located in ancient chests hidden around Bahari Bay.

items.name: Emerald
items.description: Emeralds can be randomly obtained when mining nodes of Copper Ore or Silver Ore of any size in Kilima Valley.

items.name: Jasper
items.description: Jasper can be randomly obtained while mining nodes of Stone of any size in Kilima Valley and Bahari Bay.

items.name: Gold Bar
items.description:
Gold Bars can be crafted using Gold Ore in a Basic Smelter or Heavy Smelter.
Alternatively, Gold Bars can be bought from Hodari's Mining Guild for 50 Mining Medals.

items.name: Palium Bar
items.description:
Palium Bars can be crafted using Palium Ore in a Basic Smelter or Heavy Smelter.
Alternatively, Palium Bars can be bought from Hodari's Mining Guild for 10 Mining Medals.
